justification: Adds an env-gated Google Ads conversion tag to the /duplex-check ads funnel and a one-line copy correction on the builder demo page. The tag (lib/gtag.ts) injects gtag.js on the ads landing only and fires a lead conversion on BuilderReferralCard submit; it is a no-op until NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS_ID and NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS_LEAD_LABEL are set, so the merge changes nothing live and the computed verdict path is untouched.

pre_impl.existing_data: Site analytics is PostHog only (lib/analytics.ts); there was no Google tag installed. This adds a scoped Ads tag rather than a site-wide gtag, matching the plan's decision that conversion tracking is optional for the $100 test.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Confirmed the lead submit path posts to /api/canibuildit/lead with interest_type dual-occ-referral and that the success branch already sets submitted state; the conversion fires there, after the PostHog capture, so it counts a real submit not a click.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New file lib/gtag.ts (two exported functions); the three edits are one import + one useEffect load call + one conversion call. No existing behaviour changed when the env vars are absent.

functions.name: loadGoogleAds
functions.input: no arguments; reads NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS_ID at module load and window at call time
functions.output: void; injects gtag.js once and initialises the tag, or returns early doing nothing
functions.if_none: If ADS_ID is unset or window is undefined (SSR) it returns immediately, so no script loads and nothing breaks

functions.name: trackAdsConversion
functions.input: no arguments; reads ADS_ID, LEAD_LABEL and window.gtag at call time
functions.output: void; fires a gtag conversion event to ADS_ID/LEAD_LABEL, or returns early doing nothing
functions.if_none: If either env var is missing or gtag never loaded (window.gtag undefined) it returns without firing, so a lead submit is never blocked or errored

values: N/A - no DB or API values read or written; the only external values are two public env vars read at build time, both optional.
queries: N/A - no database queries added or modified.

break_it.scenario: The env vars are unset in production (the default at merge), and a user submits the referral form.
break_it.what_happens: trackAdsConversion returns early (no ADS_ID/LEAD_LABEL); loadGoogleAds injected no script. The lead still posts and the success card still renders.
break_it.how: Both functions guard on the env vars and window before doing anything, and the conversion call sits after the fetch and PostHog capture, wrapped in the same synchronous flow that already set submitted state.
break_it.repro: Load /duplex-check with no Ads env vars, submit an eligible-result referral, confirm no network call to googletagmanager.com and the 'builder chat is being set up' card shows.

break_it.scenario: gtag.js is blocked by an ad blocker or slow network, but the env vars are set, and the user submits.
break_it.what_happens: window.gtag is undefined, so trackAdsConversion returns early without throwing; the lead is unaffected.
break_it.how: trackAdsConversion checks window.gtag exists before calling it; a missing tag degrades to no conversion recorded, never a runtime error on the submit path.
break_it.repro: Set the env vars, block googletagmanager.com in devtools, submit — the lead posts and no exception is thrown.

break_it.scenario: loadGoogleAds runs on every mount / React strict-mode double-invoke and double-injects the script or re-inits the tag.
break_it.what_happens: Duplicate gtag.js scripts or duplicate config calls could inflate or duplicate conversions.
break_it.how: A module-level `loaded` flag makes loadGoogleAds idempotent; the second call returns before appending a second script or re-configuring.
break_it.repro: In dev strict mode, mount /duplex-check and confirm only one gtag/js script tag is present in the head.

post_merge.db_reset: Not required - no schema or data changes.
post_merge.secrets: No secrets. NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS_ID and NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS_LEAD_LABEL are public client IDs (safe to expose by design); set them in the Vercel project env when the Ads conversion action is created, to activate the tag.
post_merge.other_repo: No coupling; frontend-only, deployed via Vercel.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - after setting the two env vars on a preview: open /duplex-check, run an eligible address, submit the referral form, and confirm in Google Ads (or the Tag Assistant) that one 'conversion' event fires to ADS_ID/LEAD_LABEL. With env vars unset, confirm no googletagmanager request loads at all.
